[1/3] Plan a registry-backed material texture picker with preview

impact_assessment.why: The material form accepts a free-text texture id, so imported texture assets must be typed manually and there is no visual confirmation of the selected texture.
impact_assessment.benefits: The material panel lists registry textures in a select, preserves the current texture, previews it as a thumbnail, and keeps save_material's texture payload unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: asset-filter interaction, missing/unregistered texture ids, preview absence, re-render selection loss.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use a dedicated texture select that ignores the asset text filter, preserve existing values when present, hide the preview when missing, and add static wiring regressions.

[1/3] Plan a deterministic parameter-driven animation state machine core

impact_assessment.why: The engine has clip playback and crossfades but no state machine, so games and AI clients must reimplement state, transitions and trigger handling.
impact_assessment.benefits: A validated AnimationStateMachine exposes states, parameter transitions, triggers, crossfade durations, clip events and JSON round trips for deterministic game and AI authoring.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new core module schema 1 and public exports; dependency: animation controller; concurrency: pure synchronous; state: invalid transitions, duplicate names, trigger consumption, loop/speed changes, duplicate clip names, serialization drift.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate state/transition/parameter shapes, evaluate transitions in declaration order, consume triggers on entry, use the existing deterministic controller, and add validation/transition/trigger/serialization/event tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Animation state machine core implemented: AnimationState/AnimationTransition/AnimationStateMachine with parameter operators, triggers, declaration-order transitions, crossfades, loop/speed settings, clip events, schema-1 JSON round trips, reports and public exports; docs/ADR updated; 805 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 50, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-animation-state-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan a file-backed .kstate state machine library with editor save/delete/restore and preview

impact_assessment.why: The deterministic state machine core exists, but authors and AI clients can only use it from code; there is no library, console panel or scene preview.
impact_assessment.benefits: A .kstate library stores state machine documents beside animation clips, and editor actions save, delete, restore and preview machines with parameters, triggers, fixed-step advancement and pose application.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 51 and four actions; dependency: state machine core and animation directory; concurrency: editor lock; state: malformed JSON, missing names, library collisions, trigger consumption, record-free previews, history.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate through AnimationStateMachine.from_dict, use atomic library writes and trash restore, fixed-step previews with a record flag, and add library/action/preview/error regressions.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] State machine editor integration implemented: .kstate StateMachineLibrary in the animation directory with atomic save, summaries and trash restore; save/delete/restore/preview_state_machine actions; preview applies parameters/triggers, fixed-step frames and final pose with one undo entry or record-free frames; console JSON authoring panel, library datalist and readout, schema 51; 808 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 51, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-animation-state-editor-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan load-state-machine into the editor JSON authoring panel

impact_assessment.why: Saved .kstate machines can be previewed but not loaded back into the console JSON panel, so editing a saved machine requires external files.
impact_assessment.benefits: load_state_machine returns the saved document and the console fills the name and JSON textarea, completing the author-save-load-preview loop.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 52 and one action; dependency: state machine library; concurrency: editor lock; state: missing names, malformed documents, large documents, stale last document.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate names, reuse library load errors, reset the loaded document on every action, and add load/missing/no-library/static tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] load_state_machine implemented: requires a state machine library, validates the name, returns state_machine_document (name, machine) for console editing and resets it on the next action; console Load state machine button fills the name/JSON panel; schema 52; 808 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 52, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan assigning shared mesh/material assets to the multi-node selection

impact_assessment.why: Asset assignment only targets one node, so a multi-selection cannot share or clear a mesh/material in one edit.
impact_assessment.benefits: assign_asset_selection applies validated mesh/material ids to every selected node in one undo entry, with a console Assign to selection control.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 53 and one action; dependency: AssetRegistry; concurrency: editor lock; state: empty selection, invalid ids, clearing both fields, nested selected nodes, undo grouping.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse assign_assets validation per node, resolve selected nodes under the editor lock, wrap the whole loop in one history entry, and add multi-node/undo/error tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Multi-selection asset assignment implemented: assign_asset_selection applies validated mesh/material ids to every selected node inside one undo entry; console Assign to selection sends only non-empty fields; empty selection and invalid assets return 400; schema 53; 809 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 53, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan copy/paste for the multi-node selection using a detached prefab clipboard

impact_assessment.why: Multi-selection can transform and delete nodes but cannot copy/paste them, and duplicate only handles one node at a time.
impact_assessment.benefits: copy_selection captures top-level selected nodes as a detached clipboard prefab; paste_nodes instantiates fresh IDs under a chosen parent in one undo entry; console Copy/Paste controls.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 54 and two actions; dependency: Prefab capture/instantiate; concurrency: editor lock; state: empty selection/clipboard, nested selections, mixed parents, prefab-link rebasing, undo grouping.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse save_prefab_nodes folding and shared-parent validation, keep the clipboard detached, instantiate with fresh IDs, wrap paste in one history entry and add copy/paste/undo/error tests.
